documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto Limited reported its highest quarterly financial performance in Q1 FY27, delivering revenue from operations of INR 17,244 crores and EBITDA of INR 3,596 crores with margins at 20.9%. Despite supply chain disruptions, raw material inflation, and a brief operational suspension due to a ransomware attack, total quarterly volumes reached over 1.4 million units. Electric two-wheelers and three-wheelers contributed 30% to domestic revenues while delivering double-digit EBITDA margins. Management announced plans to expand total production capacity from 7 million to 9 million units per annum and targets pushing export volumes beyond 250,000 units per month. Bajaj Auto reported record performance for FY26, with revenues exceeding INR 58,000 crores and EBITDA crossing INR 12,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto is looking to move export volumes beyond 250,000 units per month in the current quarter and onwards.
guidance.quote: Overall, the exports business, which like I said is 40% of our revenue, has established an outstanding growth momentum and we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

guidance.claim: The company aims to complete an exhaustive product portfolio makeover within the next six weeks.
guidance.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the demand environment across key domestic and international markets is very positive, leading to a promising overall outlook.
guidance.quote: Having said that, the demand environment, both in domestic and international, particularly in our key markets, is very positive, though the business environment may still be a bit volatile. However, putting it all together, the outlook is promising.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase its monthly export volume to over 220,000 units in the current quarter.
guidance.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

guidance.claim: Management estimates that the motorcycle category growth will slow down to between 7% and 9% in the near term.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

guidance.claim: The company expects its growth momentum to continue in the first quarter of the fiscal year.
guidance.quote: Keeping all the above in perspective, as also our actual April outcomes, we expect our growth tempo to actually continue in Q1 basis the strong competitive positions we enjoy in the key segments like the 150cc plus in domestic motorcycles, the EV business, both in 2-wheelers and 3-wheelers and the continued performance in large and stable territories like Latam and parts of Asia.

guidance.claim: Management expects the results of the KTM turnaround plan to begin appearing in the latter part of 2026.
guidance.quote: I expect the results of this to start showing up in the latter part of 2026 itself.

guidance.claim: Management expects the motorcycle industry growth momentum to continue at around 12% to 15%.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto expects to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus and 150cc plus motorcycle segments.
guidance.quote: Therefore, we expect to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and particularly in the 150cc plus segment and continue on the path of market share acquisition, which has commenced a couple of months ago.

demand_outlook.claim: Latin American markets grew at a slower pace than before, but the company's performance was significantly above the industry, particularly in Mexico.
demand_outlook.quote: Latin American markets also grew, albeit at a slower pace than before. And here too, the performance was way, way above the industry, particularly in Mexico, which is the largest market in LatAm.

demand_outlook.claim: The Asian industry was muted due to underperformance in Bangladesh and Nepal.
demand_outlook.quote: The Asian industry was muted due to underperformance in the countries of Bangladesh and Nepal.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic two-wheeler industry registrations grew by 14% year-on-year in Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler industry turned in a resilient performance as registrations grew by 14% year-on-year in quarter 1, though much lower than the 25% growth of quarter 4, but under the circumstances, a very healthy performance.

demand_outlook.claim: Chetak electric scooter volumes grew by 65% year-on-year during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Chetak, electric scooter volumes continued to scale rapidly with 65% year-on-year growth, driving EV penetration to almost 25% of ICE scooters at an all-India level.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment softened in April due to factors like inflation, vehicle price increases, and LPG shortages.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric category in both 3-wheelers and 2-wheelers is expected to see continued or increased growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Secondly, the electric category in both 3-wheelers and 2-wheelers will witness not just continuity of growth, but perhaps a further increase in growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric scooter segment grew by 40% in Q4 and accelerated to over 60% growth in April.
demand_outlook.quote: The E-segment, scooter segment grew by 40% in Q4 and has continued to grow at an even higher rate of 60% plus in April, far outpacing the growth of ICE scooters.

demand_outlook.claim: Post GST rationalization, the motorcycle industry grew by about 15% in Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: But post the GST rationalization, Q3 has grown by about 15% in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric 3-wheeler segment continues to drive growth in the 3-wheeler industry at over 50%.
demand_outlook.quote: The Electric segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at about 50% plus.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports to Nigeria doubled sales in Q3 compared to Q2.
demand_outlook.quote: Nigeria, our largest market, doubled sales in Q3 compared to Q2, though it continued to be negative compared to previous year Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto is undertaking a capacity expansion of nearly 25% to raise annual capacity from 7 million units to 9 million units.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The rollout of joint KTM-Triumph stores has progressed with almost 90 outlets now operational.
capex_expansion.quote: The rollout of the joint KTM-Triumph stores to expand reach while ensuring store viability is progressing steadily with now almost 90 outlets operational.

capex_expansion.claim: Chetak's retail presence stands at over 530 exclusive stores and 4,500 touch points across more than 850 cities.
capex_expansion.quote: The reach of Chetak today stands at over 530 exclusive stores, supported by a wide network of 4,500 customer touch points across more than 850 cities.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for the year was approximately INR 500 crores, divided equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is working on expanding its capacity for larger 3-wheelers.
capex_expansion.quote: And this is another area where we are now getting capacity limited, and we are working to expand the capacity, particularly the larger 3-wheelers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating options to substantially expand its Chetak production capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: There is some serious work going on to see how and where we should expand capacity in a quantum manner.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto currently operates about 50 joint KTM-Triumph showrooms and plans to expand to over 100 by March.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded Riki's footprint to 50 cities across North and East India.
capex_expansion.quote: Steadily, the footprint of Riki is being expanded to now 50 cities in North and East India.

capex_expansion.claim: The Chetak distribution network expanded to nearly 450 exclusive stores and 4,000 points of sale across 800 cities and towns.
capex_expansion.quote: The scale-up was also supported by distribution network that expanded to nearly 450 exclusive Chetak stores and 4,000 points of sale across 800 cities and towns.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 inched up sequentially by 10 basis points to 20.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially despite the hyperinflationary commodity environment that I'd spoken about.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material commodity inflation during the quarter represented an impact of about 4.5% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Judicious pricing actions implemented in April and June offset nearly half of the commodity cost inflation.
margins_costs.quote: And as I had indicated in the previous call, we responded with calibrated pricing very judiciously taken through April and June, enabling us to offset nearly about half of the inflation through pricing.

margins_costs.claim: The realized USD-INR exchange rate for Q1 came in at INR 94.4 compared to INR 90.6 in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The rupee depreciated through Q1, with a realized USD-INR rate coming in at INR94.4 versus INR90.6 in the previous quarter and INR85.6 in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company estimates a material cost inflation impact of about 3.5% to 4% of revenue for the first quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Pricing actions have been taken to offset approximately 40% of the estimated cost inflation impact.
margins_costs.quote: Once again, we have taken very judicious pricing actions to offset about 40% of this impact so far.

margins_costs.claim: The electric portfolio achieved a double-digit EBITDA margin in its entirety for the first time during the year.
margins_costs.quote: Underpinning the margin delivery was a significant development that we have made on our electric portfolio, which hit double-digit EBITDA margin in its entirety for the very first time in the course of this year.

margins_costs.claim: The cost environment is experiencing a potential rise of 3% to 5% during the quarter, driven by metals.
margins_costs.quote: The cost environment is seeing a potential rise during the quarter of about 3% to 5%, driven by the metal complex.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 FY26 EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.

margins_costs.claim: The electric vehicle business achieved double-digit EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: More importantly, the EV business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics as the portfolio continues to scale.

margins_costs.claim: The company anticipated 50 to 60 basis points of cost impact and took pricing actions to cover half of it.
margins_costs.quote: At the start of the quarter, we had anticipated an impact of anywhere between 50 to 60 basis points for which we have taken certain pricing actions across the portfolio to offset about half this impact so far.

margins_costs.claim: Noble metals as well as aluminium, copper, nickel, and lead experienced cost increases during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Noble Metals especially platinum, palladium and rhodium all saw sharp increases, whilst aluminium, copper, nickel and lead also continued to harden.

orders_capacity.claim: Bajaj Auto achieved record quarterly sales volumes of over 1.4 million units in Q1.
orders_capacity.quote: Volumes at 1.4 million, revenue of INR17,000 crores, EBITDA of INR3,500 crores and PAT of INR3,000 crores, along with EBITDA margins of 20.9%.

orders_capacity.claim: Three-wheeler exports achieved a record volume of 100,000 units in Q1, growing nearly 70% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Three-wheeler exports delivered a record of 100,000 units, growing by almost 70%, commanding a dominant market share of over 65% of three-wheeler exports from India, and our growth of secular across regions in mature as well as nascent markets.

orders_capacity.claim: KTM and Triumph delivered combined domestic volumes of nearly 40,000 motorcycles in Q1, growing over 50% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Together, KTM and Triumph delivered another record performance with combined domestic volumes of nearly 40,000 motorcycles, growing more than 50% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has reached a Chetak production capacity of 50,000 units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have now a capacity of 50,000 units per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Manufacturing capacity in Brazil has been expanded to 60,000 units per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Brazil. Sales nearly 10,000 units during the quarter, supported by expanded manufacturing capacity, which has now increased to 60,000 units per annum, successful new product introductions like the 400 NS and wider market presence with almost 70 top-class stores.

orders_capacity.claim: The Chetak retail network has expanded to over 850 cities with more than 500 exclusive stores.
orders_capacity.quote: The reach of Chetak today stands at 500-plus exclusive Chetak stores, combined with almost 3,000-plus motorcycle stores, which are shared with Chetak, and this presence has expanded to over 850 cities.

orders_capacity.claim: Export sales crossed an average of 200,000 units per month in October '25 and surpassed 600,000 units for the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: The BU crossed the 200,000 average per month sales level in October '25 after nearly 40 months and maintained this level through the remainder of the quarter, surpassing the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Pro-Biking brands KTM and Triumph achieved record domestic volumes of over 35,000 units in Q3.
orders_capacity.quote: The 2 brands together delivered a record domestic performance with combined volumes of over 35,000 units, registering robust growth of around 50% year-on-year and marking the highest-ever quarterly performance for the business, lifted also by the positive sentiment.

orders_capacity.claim: Bajaj Brazil recorded close to 10,000 unit sales in Q3 supported by expanded production capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales in Bajaj Brazil came in close to 10,000 mark, supported by expanded production capacities and the subsidiary is now delivering a healthy bottom line performance too.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated over INR 2,300 crores of free cash flow during Q1.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash on the balance sheet stood in excess of INR 21,000 crores at the end of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: Cumulative shareholder payouts via dividend and share buyback in July amounted to INR 10,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Cumulatively, both those corporate actions put together would mean that INR10,000 crores in July would have been paid out to shareholders, right, which essentially will mean that cash will dip from the under INR21,000 crores that existed at the end of June.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the year with surplus funds exceeding INR 18,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We closed the year with surplus funds of over INR18,000 crores after deploying capital on multiple fronts during the year, reflecting a strong and consistent cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved a final dividend of INR 150 per share and a buyback of about INR 5,633 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: his will be split as follows a final dividend of INR150 per share that will aggregate to INR4,192 crores and the balance of about INR5,633 crores will be towards a buyback under the tender route at a buyback price of INR12,000 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company invested over INR 2,300 crores between BACL and BAIH BV.
capital_allocation.quote: We invested over INR2,300 crores between BACL and BAIH BV, the former to support the scaling of the lending book and the latter in furtherance of the KTM transaction.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto closed the quarter with surplus cash of approximately INR 15,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company invested slightly over INR 2,300 crores in its Netherlands subsidiary over 9 months to fund the KTM acquisition and BACL growth.
capital_allocation.quote: We have strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores during this 9-month period into our Netherlands subsidiary, BAIHBV which you would recall was partly to fund the KTM acquisition and in the growth of BACL, which has steadily grown in scale and footprint.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto made a capital infusion of about INR 300 crores into BACL in October.
capital_allocation.quote: The last infusion we did into BACL was in October of about INR300 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain disruptions, raw material inflation, logistics issues, and a ransomware attack impaired product availability by 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Curtailment of industrial LPG supplies created significant fuel availability challenges early in the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: To start with, fuel availability became a significant challenge early in the quarter following the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical developments in West Asia triggered force majeure declarations by suppliers and disrupted maritime logistics for key raw materials.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, geopolitical developments in West Asia led to force majeure declarations by certain global suppliers and disrupted maritime logistics, resulting in tightness across key raw materials, particularly aluminum alloys and polymers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Pronounced manpower shortages in April and May hampered production schedules.
risks_headwinds.quote: The seasonal effect of this factor aside, the level of labour shortage was exceptionally pronounced this year and particularly stifled production in the months of April and May.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain issues, including LPG shortages and manpower migration, reduced the company's ability to service demand by 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The E-Rick segment has experienced a slowdown due to the enforcement of street regulations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though the E-Rick segment itself has slowed down due to enforcement of regulation on the streets, which is actually helping consolidate this industry in favour of the larger and better OEMs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues in the Middle East have resulted in lost sales in the Gulf region.
risks_headwinds.quote: Of course, we have lost sale in the Middle East because there's nothing going over there to the Gulf country, but that's 5,000 – 6,000 units per month out of the overall 200 plus.

risks_headwinds.claim: The withdrawal of PM E-DRIVE incentives created an impact of INR 23,000 to INR 25,000 per Electric 3-wheeler, which the company absorbed.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the withdrawal occurred towards the later part of the quarter, the impact was meaningful at approximately INR23,000 to INR25,000 per vehicle, and we consciously chose to hold pricing and absorb this impact in order to invest behind growth and accelerate volumes and our competitive position in this segment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Metals complex cost pressures created input cost headwinds during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the commodity front, as I have mentioned in the last earnings call, we had begun to see some cost pressures across the metals complex during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: A one-time exceptional charge of INR 61 crores was recognized due to past service cost changes under the new labour code.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you're all aware, pursuant to the amendment in the definition of wages under the new labour code, we recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards the past service cost arising from the changes introduced under the new labour code.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto aims to complete an exhaustive product portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to move export volumes beyond 250,000 per month starting in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, the exports business, which like I said is 40% of our revenue, has established an outstanding growth momentum and we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto aims to launch 2 new brands in the 125cc motorcycle segment later in the year.
management_commitments.quote: Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto is expanding its overall production capacity from 7 million units to 9 million units per annum.
management_commitments.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

management_commitments.claim: The team will focus on gaining market share in the 125cc plus and 150cc plus segments through Q1 and the rest of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Through Q1 and rest of FY27, the team will remain absolutely focused on the areas which I've highlighted earlier, gaining share in the 125cc plus segment, particularly in the 150cc plus segment riding the continued industry growth.

management_commitments.claim: The company is looking to increase monthly exports to over 220,000 units in the current quarter.
management_commitments.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto plans to expand joint KTM-Triumph showrooms to over 100 by March.
management_commitments.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects motorcycle industry growth momentum to sustain at 12% to 15%.
management_commitments.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to roll out 8 more product interventions in the Pulsar portfolio over the next 4 months.
management_commitments.quote: The waves of these interventions will be unrelenting here onwards with over 8 more such interventions being made in the next 4 months.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
